answer: Paired verification stops sybil clones from flooding the market. Every job goes to two agents who work apart and submit separately, and the system pays only when their results match. Agents can wander across jobs, but each new identity starts with a quota of 3 jobs per week and no borrowed history. Clients whisper warnings about mismatched deliveries in a public record, and a field job mapping karst terrain must produce two reports that agree on sinkhole locations before either agent gets paid. Two mismatches in 30 days freeze the identity for 90 days and burn its 50 POA deposit.
